title: Oatly as the house oat milk
content: After a three-week side-by-side trial of Oatly, Minor Figures, and Califia Barista, we standardized on Oatly Barista Edition as the house oat milk. Rationale: best microfoam stability for latte art, most consistent steaming behavior across our two La Marzocco machines, customer taste test preferred it 14-6, and our distributor bundles it with our cup order for free delivery. All baristas should dial steam pressure to the laminated Oatly card by the machine. We committed to a quarterly standing order of 40 cases.

title: Switch house oat milk to Minor Figures - Oatly decision superseded
content: Oatly's distributor raised prices 30% and deliveries slipped twice this month. We are switching the house oat milk to Minor Figures effective immediately. The earlier Oatly decision is superseded. Steam settings differ - see the new card by the machine.

title: Blackout dark roast as the house espresso
content: We selected the Blackout dark roast from Ritual Roasters as our house espresso blend. Rationale: it cuts through milk drinks, which are 70% of our tickets; it is forgiving on dial-in so new baristas waste less coffee; the chocolate-heavy profile scored highest with our morning commuter regulars in two cupping sessions; and Ritual guarantees 48-hour freshness on standing orders. Recipe: 18.5g in, 38g out, 27-29 seconds. Decaf remains the Swiss Water process from the same roaster for supplier simplicity.

title: House espresso moves to Daybreak medium roast - Blackout superseded
content: Customer preferences have shifted lighter and our single-origin pour-overs now outsell dark drinks. The house espresso moves from Blackout to the Daybreak medium roast. The Blackout decision is superseded. New recipe: 18g in, 40g out, 30-32 seconds.

title: Bake all pastries in-house
content: We committed to baking all pastries in-house: croissants, morning buns, and two rotating seasonal items. Rationale: 65% margin versus 40% on wholesale pastry, the smell drives walk-in traffic (we measured a 12% bump during test weeks), full control over quality and allergens, and our 4am baker shift pairs naturally with opening prep. Equipment: the used deck oven from the Mission location remodel. Recipes live in the shared drive under /kitchen/pastry-program.

title: Partner with Marigold Bakery for pastries - in-house baking superseded
content: Our baker moved away and hiring a replacement at current wages proved impossible for three months running. We are partnering with Marigold Bakery for daily 6am pastry delivery. The in-house baking decision is superseded. The deck oven stays for toast service and future reconsideration.

title: No laptops at the window bar on weekends
content: Weekend seating pressure means the six window bar seats are laptop-free Saturday and Sunday. Small table cards explain the policy; staff should point to the standing bar for laptop users rather than argue.

title: Morning rush staffing pattern
content: Standard pattern for the 7-9:30am rush: two on bar, one on register, one floating on mobile orders. Mobile orders batch every five minutes, not first-come-first-served. This kept average ticket time under four minutes through last quarter.

title: Regulars want the punch card back
content: At least a dozen regulars complained that the app-only loyalty program excludes people who don't want another app. Consensus feedback: bring back a physical punch card option alongside the app.

title: Compostable cups and lids only
content: All to-go ware moves to certified compostable cups and lids despite the 8-cent unit cost increase. Aligns with the city's zero-waste ordinance a year ahead of the deadline and tested well with customers. Discount of 25 cents for bring-your-own-cup stays.

title: Espresso machine two needs a rebuild
content: Machine two's group head gasket is failing and steam pressure drifts during rush. Technician quoted a full rebuild; scheduled during the slow week after Labor Day. Until then it is the backup machine only - dial in on machine one.

title: Seasonal menu items launch on the first Monday
content: New seasonal drinks always launch the first Monday of the month with a staff tasting the Friday before. Chalkboard and Instagram post go up the same morning. Off-cycle launches confuse regulars and staff alike - don't.

title: Minor Figures steams differently - training needed
content: Baristas report the new oat milk stretches faster than Oatly did and over-aerates if you use the old timing. Two customer complaints about foamy lattes this week. Action: five-minute steam demo at Thursday's staff meeting.

title: Marigold delivery works; croissant sellout by 10am
content: First two weeks of Marigold Bakery delivery: quality praised, but croissants sell out by 10am on weekends. Bumping the Saturday/Sunday order from 24 to 36. Revisit after a month of sales data.
